question: How long is the Migadu free trial, and what are its daily message and storage quotas? (unverified: behind a sign-up)
why: Migadu's terms say only that the free trial has a time limitation and a subset of the paid plans' features and quotas; no first-party page read states the length or the quotas, and the signup page asks for an existing email address and no card. One third-party user report (stacker.news/items/83467) describes a two-week trial. Only an account shows the length and the quotas, so this is a step for the operator.
